name: Large-Scale Source Indicator
definition: For every coordinate reflection $\rho$ for which $C\triangle\rho$ is union closed, let $\varepsilon_\infty(C\triangle\rho)$ be one when some negative source system has a directed cycle among its inequalities $r(p)\to j$ and zero otherwise. Then $\eta_\infty(C)$ is the minimum of these values; the minimum of the empty set is $+\infty$.
normalization: Minimize over all union-closed coordinate reflections; constant coordinates may be suppressed.
comments: The orientations minimizing $\eta_0$ and $\eta_\infty$ need not coincide. On partial cubes the signed-coordinate invariance makes this an abstract graph invariant.
